title.zh: 将高山省Bontoc市镇Tucucan描笼涯的Mountain Province普通综合中学附属校分离出来，单独改设为独立的Tucucan国立中学，并为此拨付经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School - Tucucan Annex in Barangay Tucucan, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province from the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tucucan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tucucan của Trường Trung học Toàn diện Mountain Province General tại Barangay Tucucan, Đô thị Bontoc, Tỉnh Mountain Province khỏi Trường Trung học Toàn diện Mountain Province General và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tucucan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tucucan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจร Mountain Province General ในบารังไกย์ Tucucan เทศบาล Bontoc จังหวัด Mountain Province ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจร Mountain Province General และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tucucan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tucucan, Sekolah Menengah Terpadu Mountain Province General di Barangay Tucucan, Kotamadya Bontoc, Provinsi Mountain Province dari Sekolah Menengah Terpadu Mountain Province General dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tucucan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Tucucan, Sekolah Menengah Menyeluruh Mountain Province General di Barangay Tucucan, Perbandaran Bontoc, Wilayah Mountain Province daripada Sekolah Menengah Menyeluruh Mountain Province General dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tucucan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School - Tucucan Annex in Barangay Tucucan, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province is hereby separated from the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Tucucan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School - Tucucan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tucucan National High School.

Appropriations. The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Tucucan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School - Tucucan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
